audit_limitations: This audit is a provisional LLM analysis of synthetic wearable data against anonymous text representations. No clinical conclusions can be drawn. The PROVISIONAL_LLM_GOLD labels are fallible and not human ground truth. Knowledge applicability was assessed strictly from the provided positive list without external verification. The constant 480-minute low-movement value in the window period is noted as a data observation; attributing it to device behavior versus genuine behavioral change cannot be resolved from the available fields. All arithmetic comparisons use the provided derived_statistics and raw observations without independent recalculation beyond what is shown.
